shift_swaps.title: Shift Swaps
shift_swaps.subtitle: Manage shift swap requests between employees

messages.create_error: Failed to create shift swap request.

guide.title: How to Use
guide.intro: Shift Swap allows admins to exchange work schedules between two employees on the same day. The system automatically detects current shifts and updates the roster upon approval.
guide.step1_desc: Click "Create Swap Request", select the Requester and Target employee (must be different), choose the swap date, and optionally enter a reason.
guide.step2_desc: After creation, the system automatically looks up the current shifts for both employees on the swap date. Shift details are displayed in the request table.
guide.step3_desc: Hover over a request in the "Pending Approval" tab to reveal the Approve (✓) or Reject (✗) buttons. On approval, shifts are swapped automatically.
guide.note1: Shifts are auto-detected by priority: Manual Roster → Individual Pattern → Assignment Rules → Department Pattern.
guide.note2: On approval, the system swaps roster entries automatically. Employee A receives B's shift and vice versa.
guide.note3: On rejection, rosters remain unchanged. Already processed requests cannot be re-approved.
